findings.detail: The new `disabled={… || mappedCount === 0 …}` guard is the right fix for the silent 'perfect match' bug, but the only explanation is `title={mappedCount === 0 ? 'Map at least one column to compare' : undefined}`. A disabled `<button>` is removed from the tab order and does not fire hover in several browsers, so a keyboard or screen-reader user sees a greyed-out control with no reason given — the `addLog` warning at the top of `handleCompare` is now unreachable, because the click can never land. Raise this to medium if the compare screen is ever the only path to the feature for an assistive-tech user; today the mapping UI directly above gives some context.
findings.summary: Disabled Run button explains itself only via `title`

findings.detail: `openWith(app: any, page: Page, …)` introduces an unjustified `any` in a file the PR adds. The concrete type is already exported from the module this spec imports from — `e2e/fixtures.ts:7` re-exports `AppShell`, and `Fixtures['app']` is declared as `AppShell` at `e2e/fixtures.ts:65`. Two sibling specs (`exporter-date-format.spec.ts:49`, `files-validation.spec.ts:46`) already use the typed form, so this is drift rather than a missing type. Concretely: a rename or signature change to `AppShell.openTool`/`goto` will not fail type-check in this spec, and the failure will surface only as a runtime Playwright error.
findings.summary: New helper annotates the `app` fixture as bare `any`
